purpose: Prospective development-only test of FFT sample-zero accounting and one phase/time gauge shared by both polarizations after the windowed-gauge pilot.
fft_epoch_convention: The physical time of FFT index zero relative to the continuous orbital-frequency peak is physical_epoch + (conditioned_retained_samples - fft_samples) * dt_seconds. Save raw, pad/crop-only after exp(-2 pi i f * (retained - fft_samples) * dt_seconds), and full physical-epoch after the additional exp(-2 pi i f * physical_epoch). These are diagnostic accounting transforms, not production ROM gauges.
shared_gauge_convention: Fit the plus-polarization unwrapped phase with the frozen quadratic 100 +/- 2 Hz window after FFT epoch correction. Apply the same removed phase and slope to plus and cross. Never fit cross independently for the primary comparison.
interpretation: Both adjacent cadence pairs, both polarizations, every declared subband, ratio consistency, synthetic controls, support and unwrapping, and nonincreasing complex error at the finer pair must pass. Raw, pad/crop-only, and full physical-epoch ungauged differences distinguish discrete FFT placement from peak-chart changes; these descriptive differences have no release gate. A failure remains visible and does not invite threshold tuning. A pass covers only these two scalar CPU rows and this frequency band; it neither qualifies the physical generator nor ROM training, interpolation, gradients, broader domain, or release. The original local-gauge failures remain failed. Both reserved ROM holdouts remain untouched.
